locator: Nestlé packaging sustainability progress page, section « What progress has Nestlé made on packaging sustainability by 2025? »
summary: Nestlé reports for the end of 2025: 89.5% of packaging met reusable, recyclable or compostable criteria; 87.5% of plastic packaging was designed for recycling; virgin plastic use was 28% lower than the 2018 baseline; recycled content represented 20.6% of plastic packaging.
limitations: Company-reported performance. Design criteria do not measure actual collection or recycling rates in each market. The combined 89.5% indicator includes reusable, recyclable and compostable packaging.
